conditions.runtime_scope: Test JEM and the ordinary local dedicated server

conditions.weather_scope: Particle Rain client particles and Weather Glass client rendering

change.summary: Replace Small Ships with Archie's Dinosaurs, remove Recruits, preserve Whaleborne and the submarine, and repair weather, glass, HUD, settlement security and catalog ownership

modifiers.before: Sculksaur summon and instant-kill logic applies to every Warden
modifiers.after: Blood Moon Wardens cannot summon a Sculksaur and ignore Sculksaur damage

modifiers.before: default water rain because the custom resource path was not loaded
modifiers.after: Particle Rain renders sandstorms only for reviewed dry NONE biomes and red sandstorms only for reviewed dry badlands. The false candidates oceanicrealms:sandstone_ocean, spawn:sandy_island, terralith:cave/desert_caves, terralith:gravel_desert and terralith:snowy_badlands retain their native precipitation instead of receiving a dry storm override.

modifiers.before: Serene Seasons tropical wet-season handling could change minecraft:desert, minecraft:badlands, minecraft:eroded_badlands and minecraft:wooded_badlands from native dry NONE precipitation to RAIN, so Weather Glass and Particle Rain both received rain state.
modifiers.after: A server biome-tag pass removes only the four vanilla dry biome IDs from sereneseasons:tropical_biomes. Native dry precipitation remains authoritative, Weather Glass reads the dry state, and Particle Rain selects the configured sand or red-sand presentation.

modifiers.before: Weather Glass plus Fusion glass models plus permanent Immersive Weathering frosty glass
modifiers.after: Weather Glass owns weather effects for vanilla and admitted modded glass while permanent frosty glass and Fusion glass models are removed

modifiers.before: Recruits mod plus JEM family, needs, payroll, quest, market, HUD and combat adapters
modifiers.after: removed from active client, server and JEM integrations; complete restore backup retained outside runtime paths
living AI-enabled iron golem count under the existing area coverage formula

cause.owner: Managed pack, JEM Server, JEM Compat and JEM Achievement Guide

rationale.purpose: Keep one clear owner for each transport, weather, glass, settlement security and catalog responsibility while adding the requested dinosaur content
rationale.decision_source: The user requested Archie's Dinosaurs, removal of Small Ships and Recruits, preservation of Whaleborne and the submarine, biome-correct storms, Weather Glass ownership, an XP-bar Locator Bar, glass-category repair and iron-golem settlement security
rationale.implementation_choices: Use Archie's native content, isolate only its proven Blood Moon Warden conflict, keep Hullback as the living surface vessel, keep the submarine as the depth vehicle, load Particle Rain rules from its actual config path, remove model owners that prevent Weather Glass from affecting vanilla glass and preserve Recruits only as a complete external restore archive

introduced.summary: Apply the requested mod and ownership changes

history.summary: Replace Small Ships, add Archie's Dinosaurs and repair the related integrations
Remove Recruits and its active JEM integrations, retain a complete external restore backup and derive settlement security from iron golems
Remove the four vanilla dry biomes from Serene Seasons tropical wet-season precipitation and remove five precipitation-enabled false candidates from Particle Rain dry-storm lists.
Archived source paths removed with Create, Immersive Aircraft and their retired integrations

relations: Whaleborne remains the living surface vessel owner
Alex's Caves submarine remains the underwater vehicle owner
Coralosaur is a tameable underwater creature and does not replace either vehicle
Weather Glass is the only active weather-on-glass presentation owner
sereneseasons:tropical_biomes -> native biome precipitation state -> Weather Glass reading
native biome precipitation state -> Particle Rain sand, red-sand or water renderer
Archie's native Sculksaur behavior remains unchanged outside Blood Moon-owned Wardens
Settlement security counts only living AI-enabled iron golems and keeps the existing area coverage formula
Recruits can be restored only from C:/MyProjects/Minecraft/JustEnoughMods Backups/JEM-Recruits-complete-2026-11-22.zip with SHA-256 B75B7BE018E3A07E91C0493ECD1DD6BFAC24E510260539B5112B531366418751
notes: Small Ships quests, hooks, speed caps, keys, configs and JARs are retired
The three time-dimension expedition now uses Hullback and submarine travel
Dry-biome storm rules include installed vanilla and reviewed modded biome IDs whose native precipitation is NONE
The Recruits restore archive contains 258 entries, including both JARs, configs, localization and all matched JEM integration source and documentation from before removal
unresolved: Final gameplay and visual acceptance requires the user's Test JEM session
